rules.label: Static core
rules.description: VPIP/PFR/hands/3-bet: the compact row that is always right.

rules.label: Opening
rules.description: Nobody has entered: RFI by position, open-limp, iso-raise.

rules.label: Facing an open
rules.description: One raise in front: fold/call/3-bet versus that position.

rules.label: Facing a 3-bet
rules.description: You opened and got 3-bet: fold/call/4-bet and the sizing.

rules.label: Squeeze
rules.description: A raise with callers behind it: squeeze and fold/call/raise versus one.

rules.label: Probe, in position
rules.description: The preflop raiser checked: probe turns and rivers in position.

rules.label: c-bet, in position
rules.description: You raised preflop and are in position: c-bet, delayed c-bet, barrels.

rules.label: c-bet, out of position
rules.description: You raised preflop and are out of position: c-bet, check-raise faced, barrels.

rules.label: Facing a c-bet, in position
rules.description: Facing the c-bet with position: fold/call/raise, float, sizing faced.

rules.label: Facing a c-bet, out of position
rules.description: Facing the c-bet out of position: check-raise, fold/call versus the sizing.

rules.label: 3-bet pot, in position
rules.description: A 3-bet pot with position: aggression and defence by street.

rules.label: 3-bet pot, out of position
rules.description: A 3-bet pot out of position: aggression and defence by street.

rules.label: 4-bet pot
rules.description: A 4-bet pot: aggressor and caller, street by street.

rules.label: Short stack
rules.description: Under 20bb: open-shove, resteal and all-in frequencies instead of raise sizes.

rules.label: Facing an overbet
rules.description: Faced with more than the pot on the river: overbet, fold-to-overbet, blockers.

rules.label: Facing a small bet
rules.description: A bet under 30% of the pot: min-bet, raise-frequency versus a small sizing.

rules.label: Deep preflop
rules.description: 150bb or deeper: open sizes and 3-bet sizes at depth, once the sample is worth reading.

rules.label: Blind defence
rules.description: A raise while in the blinds: fold/call/3-bet by the opener's position.

rules.label: Steal spot
rules.description: Unopened from a steal seat short-handed: steal, fold-to-steal, resteal faced.
